gbm_population_evidence.quote: The pathological diagnosis was glioblastoma, anaplastic astrocytoma, anaplastic oligodendroglioma, anaplastic oligodendro-astrocytoma, or subtentorial astrocytoma recurrence.

candidate_evidence.quote: The participants meeting the criteria will undergo TS-2021 oncolytic virus (5×1011PFU/ml) intratumoral injection using stereotactic technique under MR Localization.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Clinical Study on the Safety and Efficacy of TS-2021 in the Treatment of Recurrent Malignant Glioma

role_evidence.quote: A Clinical Study of the Safety and Efficacy of Third-generation Oncolytic TS-2021 in the Treatment of Recurrent Malignant Gliomas

agents.drug_class_hint: TS-2021, third-generation oncolytic adenovirus (keywords mention Ki-67, TGF-beta2, IL-15), intratumoral stereotactic injection

coder_notes: Recurrent malignant glioma incl. glioblastoma (named in conditions and inclusion); 'Glioblastoma Multiforme' -> historical. Only intervention is an oncolytic virus -> excluded at S6. Ki-67, TGF-beta2 and IL-15 appear only as keywords (likely vector design), not as biomarker roles in eligibility/design/outcomes; not recorded as biomarkers.
